title: Gerunds and infinitives: review
instructionEs: Preguntas mezcladas de toda la unidad.

items.prompt: I'm not very good at ___ names.
Would you like ___ something to drink?
items.explanationEs: Would like va con to + verbo.

items.statement: Reading before bed helps me sleep.
He suggested to go to the cinema.
items.explanationEs: Suggest va con -ing: He suggested going to the cinema.

answers: We need to buy some bread.
items.explanationEs: Need va con to + verbo: need to buy.

items.text: I'll call you after ___ (to finish) work.

items.source: They want to travel next summer.
answers: Do they want to travel next summer?
items.explanationEs: Pregunta en presente: do + they + want. Want sigue con to + verbo.

items.sentence: I don't mind wait for you.
items.explanationEs: Mind va con -ing: I don't mind waiting.
